newsitem.title: UK: GWR's Classic sees UK market share rise.
newsitem.headline: GWR's Classic sees UK market share rise.

text.p: GWR Group, which finalised the acquisition of Classic FM, said the radio station's audience had shown further growth since August when the 71.5 million stg purchase was first announced.
Classic FM's market share in the UK is currently 3.3 percent -- the highest in the station's history.
Forward advertising bookings for Classic FM for January are encouraging, GWR said.
"An early priiority for GWR is to review and develop the strategy for Classic FM, in particular for its overseas operations, GWR added.
The company said in November it would carry out an urgent reviwe of its loss-making Dutch operations. A sale would be considered if a perspective buyer emerged, GWR said at the time.
GWR issued 22.2 million new shares to help finance the Classic FM deal. Trading in the new shares will start on December 31.
